source.title: ADVO Project Proposal: Hot Shots Fuel

summary: A 20 June 2026 proposal from ADVO Web Development Services to Hot Shots Fuel for a complete website rebuild to the client's own specification, with content migration, responsive design and technical SEO, plus post-launch content management (recipes, videos, media), promotional campaign administration and system maintenance. The estimated timeframe is 1–2 weeks excluding client revisions. The fee is ₱60,000 (AUD 1,407.93) split into an ₱18,000 (AUD 422.37) downpayment and ₱42,000 (AUD 985.56) final payment, with a monthly infrastructure fee of ₱2,959.82 (AUD 70). The proposal closes with previous works: advo.ph, fourlinq.ph and felicigelato.ph. Hot Shots Fuel has no lead or proposal row in the system.

fact.claim: The proposal is from ADVO Web Development Services to Hot Shots Fuel and is dated June 20, 2026.
fact.quote: This document offers a proposal of services from ADVO Web Development Services and Hot Shots Fuel.

fact.claim: The scope is a complete website rebuild of Hot Shots Fuel to the client's specifications, with content migration, cross-device responsive design and technical SEO.
fact.quote: **Custom Development:** Complete structural rebuild, executing the precise requirements outlined in the specifications provided by Hot Shots Fuel.

fact.claim: Post-launch maintenance includes uploading and formatting new recipes, videos and media, setting up and managing competitions and promotions, and routine system maintenance.
fact.quote: **Content Management:** Systematic uploading and formatting of new recipes, videos, and general media.

fact.claim: The total estimated project timeframe, excluding client revisions, is 1 to 2 weeks.
fact.quote: | Total Estimated Project Timeframe (Excluding Client Revisions) | 1-2 weeks |

fact.claim: The downpayment on contract signing is ₱18,000.00 (AUD 422.37).
fact.quote: | Downpayment | Upon the official contract signing. | ₱18,000.00 (AUD $422.37) |

fact.claim: The final payment on delivery and sign-off is ₱42,000.00 (AUD 985.56).
fact.quote: | Final Payment | Final delivery and formal client sign-off. | ₱42,000.00 (AUD $985.56) |

fact.claim: The total fee is ₱60,000.00 (AUD 1,407.93) and covers design and development of the website.
A monthly infrastructure fee of ₱2,959.82 (AUD 70), billed on the 1st of each month, starts on final delivery and covers development updates, hosting, database and domain.
fact.quote: Upon final delivery and deployment, the Client agrees to a recurring monthly infrastructure fee of ₱2959.82 (AUD $70). This fee is billed on the 1st of every month.

fact.claim: The AUD conversions are internally inconsistent: the fee lines imply about 42.62 PHP per AUD while the infrastructure fee implies about 42.28 PHP per AUD.
ADVO cites advo.ph, fourlinq.ph and felicigelato.ph as previous works.
fact.quote: [advo.ph](http://advo.ph)The official website for ADVO Web Development Services.

fact.claim: fourlinq.ph is described as having a video landing page, scroll-based animations, consultation booking, an AI chatbot and a downloadable catalogue.
fact.quote: A business focused on supply and installation of custom-made uPVC, aluminum windows and doors.

fact.claim: felicigelato.ph is described as a live brand-consistent, mobile-responsive gelato website built from the client's social media assets with basic content management.
fact.quote: A gelato-focused food enterprise offering a wide variety of flavors and options. This website implements modern and artisan UI design from media directly taken from their social platform page

fact.claim: The proposal has no signature block, payment-term clauses, revision limits or penalty terms.
